Do you charge for delinquent slip fees? If yes, how much?

$50 / mo for monthly slip permitttes.  
$10 / day for visitor slips
Normally we charge a 35.00 late fee on a monthly basis. However, due to the COVID circumstance we have waived the fee.

Do you allow slip permit transfers? If yes, is there a fee?

Yes, Transfer fees: $175 per foot for 20' slips, $300 per foot for 25' slips, $350 per foot for 28' and 30' slips, $500 per foot for 35', $525 per foot for 40' 43' and 45', $575 for slips > 50' and $600 per foot for everything else.
First one is free, Then $50 each time after
First if free, then $50 each time after
No we do not allow permit transfers.
Yes, $36.00 to transfer to another slip
Yes, $36.00 to transfer to another slip
Yes, $20.00 per food based on the length of the boat or slip whichever is greater.

Slips are rented and the licensee cannot directly transfer their slip to someone else. Slips are managed by the Harbor and once a slip is released, it is offered based on a paid waitlist. Some exceptions apply: when a boat is sold and the slip licensee releases the slip, the new owner may occupy the slip for one year before it is offered on the wait list. Additionally, in the event of a bequest, the family may occupy the slip for 2 years before it is offered to the waitlist.

$49.00 per month per permit administration fee. $163.00 bi-annual inspection fee.
No additional charge in our marina
$4.00 per foot, based on the size of the boat or the slip which ever is greater.
Permit application fee = $104, Live Aboard Service Fee = $260.00 per month
$100.00/month per person plus 30% of slip renter utilities
Do you charge for extra occupants? If yes, how much?
$62 for second person; $51 for each additional person.
Do you charge independently or meter for utilities, or are utilities included with slip or live aboard fees?
Electric is metered. Water is included
We charge independently for electricity. All others (water, sewer, WiFi) are included
They are included in the slip rent
Included in the Live Aboard Service Fee
$35.00 for 30 AMP, $50.00 for 50 AMP, $30% of base slip rent for Live Aboard
Metered electric.  Metered water for select tenants.
Do you limit the length of time a visitor can stay? Please explain.
28 days for recreational vessels. No limit to commercial vessels with current Fish & Wildlife landing receipts.
After 10 days in a 30-day period approval must be granted by the Harbor Master. The County of Ventura needs to be listed as additional insured on the vessel's insurance.
Yes, 3 days. Some exceptions made depending on the situation and time of year.
Two weeks; longer with Harbormaster approval.
60 nights in any six month period
30 days, longer with Harbor Manager Approval
Fourteen days for nightly rental moorings, or April thru October for monthly seasonal moorings.
Up to one week if space is available.  We are primarily a commercial fishing marina; space may become available seasonally.

Impound fee $237  - Impounded Vessels daily storage rate per foot $2.52
$185.00 per hour impound towing fee plus $130.00 impound fee plus $3.00 per ft storage fee.
$185.00 per hour impound towing fee plus $130.00 impound fee plus $3.00 per ft storage fee.
Yes. $104 to impound and then $0.65/ft/night for vessels 18' and under or $1.31/ft/night for vessels over 18'
$100.00 for the police vessel  plus $50.00 per Officer
Do you provide any extra accommodations for Commercial Fishermen? Please explain:
NO, We do not rent to commercial vessels.
Yes. The District allows the temporary storage/staging of crab pots and totes on the Harford Pier
Commercial Berthing Rate $0.60/ foot per night

We have two (2) one-ton cranes on fish pier.  Our large fish pier is also used to do net repairs and scheduled through our Dockmaster's Office.  We are currently installing a 5 ton flaked ice machine on fish pier.
Do you permit outrigger/kayak/catamaran storage directly on the sand? If yes, please explain accommodation.

Yes.  
An annual permit fee of $300 per vessel shall be charged to place an outrigger, sailing outrigger, sailboat, rowing dory, or surf ski within West Beach.

An annual permit fee of $250 per vessel shall be charged to place catamarans within Leadbetter Beach.
Yes. Shore Mooring Permit Fee-Sandstake $305/11-Month Period

Elsewhere on City tidelands, yes. We have sand storage usage agreements with three different organizations for essentially no cost to the organization to encourage the cultural and recreational activities associated. the organizations also contribute to the upkeep and maintenance of the surrounding tidelands on which they store their vessels
Yes.  One of the lessee's has been granted permission to store kayaks on the beach during May - November.  The Yacht club is permitted to store a Hobie underneath the Avila Pier.
